SELECT account_code, dim_primary, dim_secondary, dim_tertiary, dim_quaternary, period, amount, input_method
      FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.FACT_PLAN_ENTRY
      WHERE version_id = 2
        AND module = 'revenue'
        
        
        
        
        
      ORDER BY account_code, dim_primary, dim_secondary, period
